description: Exact reverse-Bessel companion, every-third e-convergent, fixed-RHS Padé determinant, centered lift family, eta-bound bookkeeping, and proper-target checker
open: any lower bound log rho_n>=n log n-O(n)
an inhomogeneous shrinking-target or Ostrowski theorem using the exact endpoint
a large proper de-overlapped target residue theorem
the Item282 common product baseline and weighted-return cover
Route 1 and every conclusion about e+pi

theorem.bessel_seed: with A_n(X)=sum_k (2n-k)!/[k!(n-k)!] X^k, q_n=A_n(-1)=(-1)^n y_n(-2) and p_n=A_n(1)=y_n(2)
theorem.e_convergent: p_n/q_n is Euler's regular continued-fraction convergent of zero-based index 3n-2
theorem.homogeneous_measure_barrier: a fixed-power homogeneous lower bound for |beta*e-J|, combined only with the O(1/n) target size, forces at most a polynomial lower scale for |beta|
theorem.proper_target: for Q|q_n, the centered beta is centered(r_n mod Q) and solves p_n*beta-J*Q=2*(-1)^(n-1)*q_(n-1)
theorem.scope: no all-n half-bound, factorial lower bound, or O(n)-height lift construction is proved
